description: two identical L-bend pipes (cylinder r 2 along line 20, quarter torus R 10, line 20) crossing perpendicularly: pipe 1 along z then x, pipe 2 rotated 90 degrees about the x-axis through (0,0,10) so its first leg runs along y through (0,0,10). The two pipes cross at (0,0,10) in an exact cylinder x cylinder quartic, while their elbows and far legs remain separated by dz = 10 (plans/sweep step 7)

analytic.counts_differ: Open CASCADE splits the two crossing intersection ellipses at the cylinders' seam rulings, four vertices and six edges along the intersection (12/22/12/12/1); Arris keeps the two planar ellipses meeting at the two crossing vertices (x = ±r), two vertices and four edges (10/20/12/12/1)
